newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica confirms in bid for Russian telecom.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica confirms in bid for Russian telecom.

text.p: Spain's Telefonica confirmed on Wednesday that it was part of an international consortium bidding for 25 percent of Russian state telecoms holding company Svyazinvest.
A Telefonica spokesman said the company had submitted news of its participation to Spain's stock market commission.

Telefonica's said its international unit TISA, in a half Russian/half international consortium, paid a $400 million deposit to Russian authorities for the right to bid for the first $1.18 billion tranche.
Svyazinvest chief executive Nail Ismailov told Ekho Moskvy radio on Tuesday that he expected the auction to be decided and the results published "in literally a few days".
The Russian state plans to sell 49 percent of its wholly-owned Svyazinvest in two tranches.

Telefonica did not say who the other consortium participants were. The Spanish telecoms firm, which was fully privatised in February, is part of a global alliance with British Telecommunications and U.S.-based MCI.
